title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Copy Existing Locations to Create New Locations (Copy Location)
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 introduces a Copy Location feature that allows users to quickly duplicate existing location records to create new warehouse locations, eliminating the need for manual entry or Configuration Packages.
key_points: Copy Location is a new action available on the Locations list and Location Card pages in BC28
Users can select an existing location and copy it to create a new location with customizable fields
This feature simplifies location setup compared to traditional manual data entry or Configuration Package methods
The capability mirrors the existing Copy Item feature and could expand to other master data types

quotes.text: Traditionally, creating multiple locations required manual entry or Configuration Packages. But with this wave (BC28), it's as simple as clicking a button.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the efficiency improvement the Copy Location feature provides over previous setup methods

quotes.text: Hopefully, Microsoft expands this 'Copy' capability across all master data - it would save so much setup time!
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates the broader value and future potential of this copying pattern for other Business Central setup tasks
